name: Separate artifact creation from clean reproduction
evidence: PaperBench copies a submission into a fresh VM, executes its entrypoint, and uses resulting logs/files in grading.

operational_primitive.transformation: Execute in a fresh environment; retain newly generated files and logs separately from task-time claims.

constraints: A matching output can still reflect a wrong model or code; environment and compute costs matter.
reuse_hypothesis: A separate reproduction packet could make a physics reviewer’s inspection cheaper; effectiveness is untested here.
next_test: On one existing small result, ask a reviewer to run the pinned entrypoint in a clean environment and record missing assumptions; no new scientific campaign.
word_count_convention: Whitespace-separated tokens in recursive string values; excludes word_count and this convention; excludes JSON keys.
